events.title: Summer staffing crunch
events.description: Higher attrition and a hiring freeze cut phone headcount from about 117 to 85; waits and abandons rose.

events.title: Hiring surge
events.description: Post-freeze hiring classes finished training; agents logged in jumped 35-47% above recent weeks.

events.title: Online banking outage
events.description: Two-day online banking outage: digital access contacts spiked and service level fell to about 32%.

events.title: Data incident #1
events.description: Data incident #1, resolved in run #8. The 2 Nov contact extract ran twice after a timeout, and both copies went out in one file. The second copy was given new contact IDs.

events.title: Data incident #2
events.description: Data incident #2, resolved in run #9. A routing-platform change on 3 Nov stopped writing the agent ID on some answered contacts.

events.title: Data incident #3
events.description: Data incident #3, resolved in run #11. The agent activity extract job for 4 Nov failed, so no activity was sent and the agent-day summary was built from an empty extract (0 minutes logged in).

events.title: Data incident #4
events.description: Data incident #4, resolved in run #11. A release of the contact export on 5 Nov wrote the offered time in UTC while the other times stayed in local time, which also made wait times negative.

events.title: Data incident #5
events.description: Data incident #5, resolved in run #13. Complaint close dates on 7 Nov were read as day/month instead of month/day, so 11/09 became 11 September.

events.title: Data incident #6
events.description: Data incident #6, resolved in run #15. The 9 Nov contact file failed to transfer because a certificate on the file server had expired.

events.title: Data incident #7
events.description: Data incident #7, resolved in run #16. An email-parsing change on 10 Nov stopped matching emails, secure messages and callbacks to customers.

events.title: Data incident #9
events.description: Data incident #9, resolved in run #18. The survey vendor's new matching logic on 12 Nov credited surveys to the wrong agent.

events.title: Data incident #10
events.description: Data incident #10, resolved in run #20. After a routing-system change on 14 Nov, some contacts were assigned to recycled agent IDs that belonged to agents who had left.
